edition: California CCSS Mathematics modified January 2013, corrected 2014 electronic edition
note: Five bounded requirement summaries, not the 21-expectation full audit. These paraphrases preserve material conditions; no canonical equivalence or acceptance.

rows.scope: Solve addition and subtraction word problems within 20 across adding-to, taking-from, putting-together, taking-apart and comparing situations, unknown in any position, using objects, drawings or equations.
Add and subtract within 20; demonstrate fluency within 10; use counting on, making ten, decomposing to ten, inverse operations and equivalent easier sums.
Understand tens and ones in two-digit numerals, with separate required cases for ten as a group of ten ones, 11 through 19 as ten and ones, and decade numerals as tens with zero ones.
Measure an object's length with a whole number of identical length units placed end to end; no gaps or overlaps; restriction requires whole-number spanning units.

Partition circles and rectangles into two and four equal shares; describe shares as halves, fourths and quarters and use the phrases 'half of', 'fourth of', and 'quarter of'; describe the whole as two of, or four of, the equal shares; recognize that decomposing into more equal shares creates smaller shares.
